name: Electric Sleep
source: You wake up in a strange lab and head out to explore a desolate landscape. Through the course of your travels, you find yourself waking up in that lab over and over, but each time in the grip of a new emotion. Discover how each emotion colours your experience of the world, and the means by which you might find answers.
